subject: Urgent: pop-up sponsor area - internet & AV outage, immediate mitigation
messages:
From: Claire Hammond <claire@summitcenter.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-02T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: onsite - pop-up sponsor area status

Marcus / Vanessa —

Quick heads up from the show floor: The venue’s primary DMZ/ISP circuit dropped at 08:05; AV racks in Halls B2/B3 experienced a short power flicker when that happened. Several booth uplinks lost upstream connectivity and the PA mixer is acting up (mics popping / intermittent). We’ve routed local power to generator but it’s on a degraded transfer.

We’ve already engaged our in-house AV partner (CC’d) but given you have demos that rely on our cloud endpoint, the sponsors are asking for a mitigation plan ASAP.

I can open dock door 4 for external techs and storage is in bay C.

—Claire
Event Ops Manager
Summit Center

Attachments: floor-diagram.pdf (see booth cluster and power feeds)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Greenlight AV <support@greenlightav.com>, Tom Ellis <tellis@hotspotco.com>
Cc: Claire Hammond <claire@summitcenter.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-02T08:18:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Urgent: pop-up sponsor area - internet & AV outage, immediate mitigation

Thanks Claire — and Greenlight / Tom, pls confirm receipt. High-level plan we need:

1) Greenlight AV: Dispatch a tech to swap the booth uplink to the backup edge switch and verify the PA mixer power/grounding (ETA aim 20–30m). If you need a spare mixer channel, use the one in storage bay C and route to the sponsor island.

2) Tom / HotspotCo: We need 6 LTE hotspots provisioned to the sponsor VLAN and two USB-C battery packs for demos. I’m authorizing expedited delivery to dock 4. ETA target 30–45m. Please attach order confirmation.

3) Vanessa / Marissa: Prep an offline fallback for demos — slide deck + short pre-recorded video the sponsor can run locally; switch any live demo to local (edge) inference. Karthik, I’ll need a small packaged runtime that runs on a MacBook/Linux box with minimal dependencies.

I’m looping in Karthik for the local-inference bundle and Marissa for order/expenses. Attach floor-diagram.pdf for reference.

If Greenlight can also supply a temporary analog feed to the PA (line out) so mic load reduces, that’ll help. Keep me posted every 15m.

—Marcus
Director, Field Events | Redwood Inference
From: Greenlight AV <support@greenlightav.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Hammond <claire@summitcenter.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-02T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Urgent: pop-up sponsor area - internet & AV outage, immediate mitigation

Marcus —

We’re on it. Two techs in truck #7 en route, ETA 22 minutes. Plan of action on arrival: 1) Verify generator transfer stability; 2) Move booth uplink to backup managed switch, confirm VLAN tagging; 3) Swap mic channel to spare preamp and test; 4) Provide analog line out to PA for immediate pass-through.

We’ll bring a spare 16-port PoE switch and a battery-backed UPS for the AV rack. Quoting our temporary service in attached vendor-quote-greenlight-av.pdf.

—Tom G. (on behalf of Greenlight AV)
Greenlight AV Support
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Hammond <claire@summitcenter.com>, Greenlight AV <support@greenlightav.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Urgent: pop-up sponsor area - internet & AV outage, immediate mitigation

Copy — I’m with the sponsor at the island. Quick status: team already moved the audience seating and are OK with starting on the fallback. I’ve queued the local video and printed the slide packet.

Requests for logistics team: please send two spare HDMI monitors from show storage (bay C) and a lightning adaptor for the iPad presenter. Also, confirm that the sponsor is comfortable with demos on cellular (I told them we’d prioritize ethernet but will ask).

I’ll switch the session to the 10:00 slot if we can’t confirm full connectivity by 09:10.

—Vanessa
Senior Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-02T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Urgent: pop-up sponsor area - internet & AV outage, immediate mitigation

Marcus / team —

I’m packing a minimal local inference bundle now: a containerized runtime and a small sqlite cache of required prompts/models. It runs on macOS/Linux with Docker or our portable binary if Docker is blocked. I’ve attached the runbook (local-inference-runbook.txt) with commands:

- boot: ./run_local_inference.sh --port 8080 --cache assets/cache.sqlite
- health: curl http://localhost:8080/health
- demo script: run_demo_local.sh (presenter-facing UI)

If Greenlight can provide local NAT for the hotspot VLAN, we can assign static routes and reduce failover flakiness. If the sponsor needs offline tokens, I’ll generate a short-lived signed token valid 2 hours.

I’ll be at dock 4 with a spare MacBook and HDMI dongles in 18m.

—Karthik
Staff ML Engineer, Inference
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Hammond <claire@summitcenter.com>, Greenlight AV <support@greenlightav.com>, Tom Ellis <tellis@hotspotco.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T12:04:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Urgent: pop-up sponsor area - internet & AV outage, immediate mitigation

Final update:

- Greenlight AV replaced uplink to backup switch and installed UPS on the rack at 08:40; PA stabilized after analog line-out at 08:45.
- HotspotCo delivered 6 LTE hotspots and 2 battery packs to dock 4 at 09:10 (hotspot-order-confirmation.pdf attached).
- Karthik’s local runtime deployed to the MacBook; demos were run over the hotspot VLAN and one cached video for attendees. Speaker Dr. Priya Sen presented from pre-recorded slides at 10:05 and sponsor product demo ran successfully at 10:25.
- Expense: Greenlight temporary service + Hotspot expedited fee = $1,420. I’ve uploaded the vendor quote and hotspot receipt to the event folder and placed a DocuSign approval link here: https://docusign.com/receipt/3a9b-0c7f.

Lessons & next steps: please add a pre-event checklist item to confirm generator automatic transfer and a spare local runtime for any API-dependent demos. Also recommend we pre-order 4 hotspots for premium sponsors in future shows.

I’ll open a cost approval ticket with Finance and copy leadership. Thanks to everyone for the fast coordination.

—Marissa
Field Events Ops Lead
Redwood Inference
